planning_estimate.basis: Five-route API-01 pilot measurements extrapolated to 60 runs per route; Daybreak uses the observed Sol route only as a planning proxy.
planning_estimate.interpretation: Planning estimates only. They are neither a spending authorization nor evidence of billed cost. Congestion and failures can increase elapsed time.

billing_semantics.openai_codex: Preserve provider-reported included status. Never relabel normalized API-equivalent cost as actual billed cost.
billing_semantics.opencode_go: Preserve unknown actual billing status unless authoritative billed evidence becomes available.
billing_semantics.reasoning_tokens: Report separately but do not add again when already included in output tokens.

canary_policy.selection: BUG-01, attempt 1, all six frozen routes.
canary_policy.eligibility: Canary runs count in the 360 only if every artifact passes freeze, cognitive-isolation, sandbox and checksum verification with no source modification after inference begins.
canary_policy.continuation: After a valid canary, execute the full plan with --resume so the six immutable completed run keys are reused and the remaining 354 are created. The campaign driver independently re-verifies all six canaries before submitting any non-canary cell.

stopping_rules: Do not change any frozen task, prompt, public test, private grader, reference, known-bad fixture, runner, sandbox, script, route, pricing snapshot, seed, timeout, reasoning level, toolset, memory/context/skill setting, or campaign policy after the first eligible v4 model call starts.

Do not change the externally fingerprinted Hermes launcher, root Python modules, agent/, hermes_cli/, tools/, lockfiles, Python interpreter or installed distribution versions after the first eligible v4 model call starts.
Any frozen-source change after eligible inference begins invalidates v4 in full. Preserve its artifacts, record an exclusion, and create a new campaign identifier.
A deterministic candidate rejection is a valid benchmark outcome, not an infrastructure retry.
Provider errors, timeouts and grader infrastructure failures remain recorded outcomes. Do not selectively rerun sealed completed artifacts.
Resume is permitted only for an incomplete run with an identical frozen request and run key, or to reuse an already complete checksum-valid run while executing the remaining frozen plan.
Abort continuation if freeze verification, grader commitments, cognitive isolation, tool sandbox activation, grader sandbox activation, or sealed-artifact integrity fails.
No v1, v2, v3, pilot, pre-freeze probe or fixture run may be included in v4 metrics.
